title: Dynamic websites
description: Render pages on the server with content from a remote API, JSON data or Markdown with MDX.

title: Web applications without client-side JavaScript
description: Build interactive apps with plain HTML forms. The server does the work, and view transitions make page changes feel smooth.

title: Hypermedia with HTMX
description: Every Jeasx route can return an HTML fragment, so hypermedia libraries like HTMX and Fixi can update parts of a page with markup rendered on the server.

title: Islands of client-side JavaScript
description: Add islands of interactivity to server-rendered pages with the client-side library you already know.

title: Streaming and Server-Sent Events
description: Use the standards of the web platform: stream HTML with a Response or a ReadableStream or push live updates.

title: Images, JSON and other content types
description: Routes aren't limited to HTML: they can return images, SVG, JSON, XML or any other content type.

title: Server-side JSX with jsx-async-runtime
description: Everything jsx-async-runtime renders on the server: promises, iterables and other values as children, render props, request context via 'this', overriding how JSX turns into HTML, head management, i18n, Declarative Shadow DOM and unit tests for components.

title: Client-side JSX with jsx-async-runtime
description: Render the same JSX components on the server and in the browser with jsx-async-runtime, without React, a virtual DOM or hydration: from simple widgets to games and streamed async trees.

title: Authentication and security
description: Protect routes with basic auth or sessions, sign cookies, block injected scripts and stop bots with a proof-of-work captcha.

title: Error handling and post-processing
description: Catch errors and transform the final HTML before it is sent to the browser.
